title: Consistency of P1 and P2: locate the construction in the Thm 2.2 / Thm 2.3 gap

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Sub-lemma (G5).** Explicitly reconcile the positive clause (P1) and the negative clause (P2), which superficially look contradictory.

P1: *every* $\pi$ is $\Sigma^{in}_1$-definable from *some* finite tuple. P2: *no* fixed tuple defines all $\pi$, and for each tuple $\bar a$ a defeating $\pi$ exists *even after augmenting with $\pi(\bar a)$*. 

The proof must show there is no hidden contradiction by demonstrating that the finite tuple which defines a given $\pi$ in P1 consists of data (a base point *inside each moved gadget*) that is genuinely **not** recoverable from an arbitrary externally-chosen $\bar a\cup\pi(\bar a)$. This is precisely the gap the authors highlight between Theorem 2.2 (uniform parameters that *determine* automorphisms) and Theorem 2.3 (per-$\pi$ parameters that *define* them effectively). 

Deliverable: a short but rigorous argument that the construction inhabits exactly this gap, so that (P1) and (P2) jointly hold without contradiction.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
Finding: existing construction A FAILS P2; the earlier G5 reconciliation used a false witness-locality claim.

1) LEAK (verified): In A, D on G_0 + directed aligned spine R make sigma (and every sigma^k) Sigma^in_1-definable from the EMPTY tuple. Family: phi_0:=D(x,y); phi_n (n>=1):= exists u_0..u_n,v_0..v_n [ D(u_0,v_0) & AND_t (R(u_t,u_{t+1}) & R(v_t,v_{t+1})) & x=u_n & y=v_n ]. R is a union of directed rays so witnesses are forced (u_t=(t,a), v_t=(t,b)), D forces b=a+1, giving exactly graph(sigma). Confirmed numerically on truncation. Hence P2 is FALSE for A: sigma is definable from a-bar ∪ sigma(a-bar) for every a-bar.

2) Why old P2 broke: it transported phi_i via rho (single-gadget reflection), but rho is only an automorphism of the induced substructure on c ∪ G_{n0}; the leaking formula's witnesses run down the spine to G_0, outside that substructure, so the matrix is not preserved.

3) Correct criterion (now in solution.tex): EMBEDDING criterion. If a self-embedding h:B->B fixes c-bar pointwise and h(pi(x0)) != pi(h(x0)) for some x0, then pi is not Sigma^in_1-definable from c-bar (existentials preserved under embeddings). A correct counterexample needs (i) P1 and (ii) for each a-bar, a self-embedding fixing a-bar ∪ pi(a-bar) not commuting with pi. A fails (ii).

4) Tension = the real Thm2.2/2.3 gap: propagating a uniform orientation along a spine (needed for P1) is equally available to the adversary (defeating P2). The spine+anchor of A does not inhabit the gap.

solution.tex G5 rewritten: P1 kept (correct); old P2 replaced by Lemma(leak), Cor(P2 fails), Diagnosis remark, Embedding-criterion lemma, Spec remark, honest status theorem.

STATUS: in_progress. Reconciliation now rigorous and P1 holds, but G2's construction (def:A) must be redesigned so AUT stays countable without making orientation parameter-free/externally definable. Not closing.
